DECISION RULES: The test uses assertEquals without descriptive messages; no assertion messages are present. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Comments should explain 'why', not 'what'. RATIONALE: Excessive comments clutter tests. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if code is clean with minimal useful comments. DECISION RULES: The class contains concise Javadoc and no commented-out code within the method. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests must be deterministic. RATIONALE: Avoid flakiness from randomness or time. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if no Random(), time-based calls, or Thread.sleep. DECISION RULES: The test contains no random or time-based calls and uses only local state. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should not leave side effects or modify shared state. RATIONALE: Side effects create inter-test coupling. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if tests do not persist data or modify static globals without cleanup. DECISION RULES: The test uses local Grafo instances and does not touch files, databases, or static state. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should be categorized for selective runs. RATIONALE: Labels improve CI efficiency. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if annotations like @Tag/@Category are used. DECISION RULES: No @Category/@Tag annotations are present on the method or class (interface UnitTest exists but not used). VERDICT: non-compliant.
